## Kill Chain v2.4.0 — Stability and Cohesion

Windows desktop audio engine — EQ, spatial processing, restoration, analysis, and playback in one workspace.

First public build since v1.4.0 — it also rolls up the internal 1.5–2.3 releases (Fire Command studio, Visualizer Intelligence, 6DOF 3rd Dimension, the Sculptor repair workspace, the KCDS design system, and Tractor Beam's Full Chain Lock + Lock Library).

### Highlights

- **MISSION STATE** — one brain for all automation. A source change triggers one ordered pipeline: manual override › saved source memory › Auto-Lock › Auto-Flatten. Your hand always wins
- **Unified source memory** — locks, repairs and chains in one per-source record; sessions export as `.kcsession`
- **Mission HUD** — always-visible: tracked source, pending automation, health issues with one-click fixes
- **Failures speak up** — device loss, suspended audio, storage failures and failed exports surface as actionable alerts
- **Reset Audio Engine** — one-click recovery, no app restart
- **Hardened for long sessions** — single-instance lock, automatic crash recovery, repeatable smoke suite

### Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-2.4.0.exe` below
2. Run the installer (see SmartScreen note in README if Windows blocks it)
3. Launch from Start menu or desktop shortcut

### Requirements

Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
